chapter.heading: Zechariah 4
A Vision of a Golden Lampstand
chapter.v: 4 Andthe angel who talked with me came againand woke me, like a man who is awakened out of his sleep.

And he said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I see, and behold,a lampstand all of gold, with a bowl on the top of it, andseven lamps on it, with seven lips on each of the lamps that are on the top of it.
And there aretwo olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left.”
